title: Sheet 14 · Lockup, parts list
summary: The footer is SHEET 14/14, the last sheet of Kelwin's drawing set, on the same sheet metric as every other C sheet. A title row carries the shared C head (red-square label, a 40px two-tone uppercase statement, the 48px rule) beside a note cell and the shared door pair. The body pairs a drawing field, where the real lockup is plotted 1:1 as a 1px construction drawing, with a spec column where the Capabilities sitemap is the drawing's parts list: A–C are keyed by leaders to K1–K3, and the red plane fills the part under discussion. Firm, Resources, Location, New business and Colophon follow as cells, then the shared band and segmented title block.

reference.borrowed: Heron's whole-footer cell sheet. An uppercase statement cell sits beside mono-headed sitemap cells. NEW BUSINESS / GENERAL sub-cells stack, a wordmark is drawn as a construction drawing (1px glyph outlines, '+' registration crosshairs, faint dashed guides, one red mark), and a bottom row of cells carries the copyright, Privacy and Terms.
reference.kelwin: It sits on C's frame (verticals at x 64 / 1376, a --line-2 sheet-opening rule, crosshairs at the frame corners and at two chosen intersections) as SHEET 14/14, with C's segmented title block. Rows: (1) a title cell over cols 1–8 with the shared C head at footer scale: the red-square label 'Sheet 14/14 · Colophon', 'REVENUE INFRASTRUCTURE / FOR SERIOUS B2B.' in 40px wide caps (430, with the light 300 accent line in --fg-3, inside the founder's 32–42px small-heading band) and the 48×2 rule. Beside it, a note cell over cols 9–12 holds the 20px note and the shared C door pair: the red 'C9·R2 · Fixed scope · 10 WD / Initiate System Audit ↗' cell (/audit) and a ruled 'Contact →' cell (/contact), as on hero, method, fit and before/after, so the set closes as it opened. (2) Heron's full-width wordmark band, which would repeat option A's giant lockup, is replaced by C's drawing-field + spec-column anatomy. The founder's real lockup is plotted at SCALE 1:1 (the title block says so) as 1px outlines over dashed datums (CAP 18.25 / X-HT 43.2 / BASE 138), with dimensions in master units (734 U overall, 72 U clear space). Leaders drop from K1, K2 and K3 to lettered tags A, B and C, keyed to the spec column, which is the Capabilities sitemap as a parts list: A · K1 Narrative Systems, B · K2 GTM Infrastructure, C · K3 GTM Intelligence. Heron's lone red tick becomes C's installed red plane, filling the part under discussion (K3 at rest). (3) Firm and Resources become ID'd cell rows (F-01…, R-01…) that invert on hover, alongside a LOCATION spec table, NEW BUSINESS audit@kelwin.co / SISTER COMPANY Plurel sub-cells, and a COLOPHON spec table whose 'Set in' row reads the typefaces actually in use. Heron's building illustration is dropped, and there are no brackets, reticles or glow.

motion: entrance (drafting order, --ease-inout, ≈5.1s including the demo): the frame and crosshairs fade (300ms) and 27 cell borders draw in raster order (500ms each, 40ms stagger). The title wipes on line by line. The red square and the 48px rule follow the head. Mono IDs and keys type on at 24ms per character, in raster order. The datums fade in, then the lockup plots via stroke-dashoffset: the K1–K3 plates first, then each glyph (900ms each, 90ms stagger). Dimension lines plot and their values fade in, then the leaders plot and the A–C tags appear.

demo (the orchestrated moment): once the plot is complete, the red plane drops into K1 (≈2.7s) and steps K1 → K2 → K3 every 1.2s (600ms crossfade). The matching tag in the drawing and the matching letter in the parts list invert with it, ending at rest on K3 · GTM Intelligence.
ambient: the UTC value in the location cell changes every 6s with a 200ms digit change. Nothing else loops.

interaction: hovering or focusing a parts-list row moves the red plane to that part and inverts its row; leaving returns it to K3. Hovering a sitemap row, the contact cell or a legal cell inverts it (--fg fill, --bg text). The red audit cell deepens to --accent-hover. An X/Y readout on the right frame edge follows the cursor.

on the live site: the sheet plots once when it is 50% visible, and the K1 → K3 step is scroll-linked to the footer entering. prefers-reduced-motion shows the fully plotted sheet with the plane at rest in K3 and no typing.
notes: SHEET 14/14 follows C's homepage numbering (nav 00, hero 01 … cta 13, footer 14; interior pages carry their own C·0n/03 sheets). Coherence pass: the footer now opens on the shared 96px lead-in (its label lands at y 120 like every sheet), its head follows the shared grammar, the door pair and segmented title block match the other sheets, captions take the .18em label tracking, and the parts-list arrows are drawn rather than font glyphs. The founder's master has three pieces, so K1–K3 map to the three capabilities as the logo correction prescribes. Red: the label square and rule (founder head DNA), the action cell and the one plane. The location readout defaults to London, as the live LocationTime component does. The drawing is orthographic rather than isometric on purpose: the CTA sheet directly above already carries the exploded iso assembly.
